Title: Supplier Welcome Email
Template_Subject: Welcome to the Zylker supplier network
Template_1: Welcome to Zylker. Your supplier profile has been created successfully.
plain: Sent after a supplier is approved.

Title: Supplier Approval Request
Template_1: A new supplier registration is ready for your review and approval.

Title: Supplier Approved Notice
Template_Subject: Your supplier account has been approved
Template_1: Your Zylker supplier account is approved and ready for transactions.
plain: Sent when supplier approval is completed.

Title: Supplier Rejection Notice
Template_1: Your supplier application was not approved. Contact procurement for details.
plain: Sent when a supplier application is rejected.

Title: Purchase Order Dispatch
Template_1: A new purchase order has been issued. Please review the order details.

Title: Goods Receipt Confirmation
Template_1: The delivered goods have been received and recorded by our warehouse.

Title: Supplier Payment Advice
Template_1: Your payment has been processed. Please review the remittance details.

Title: Customer Welcome Email
Template_1: Welcome to Zylker. Your customer account is now active.

Title: Quotation Email
Template_1: Your quotation is ready. Please review the products and pricing provided.

Title: Sales Order Confirmation
Template_Subject: Your Zylker sales order is confirmed
Template_1: Your sales order has been confirmed and is being prepared for fulfillment.

Title: Shipment Dispatch Notice
Template_1: Your order has left our warehouse and is on its way to you.
plain: Sent when a shipment is dispatched.

Title: Delivery Confirmation
Template_1: Our records show that your order was delivered successfully.

Title: Invoice Email
Template_1: Your invoice has been generated and is available for payment.

Title: Payment Receipt
Template_1: Thank you. Your payment has been received and applied to your account.

Title: Payment Reminder
Template_1: This is a friendly reminder that an invoice on your account remains outstanding.
plain: Sent before an invoice becomes overdue.

Title: Overdue Invoice Notice
Template_1: Your invoice is overdue. Please arrange payment or contact our finance team.

Title: Credit Limit Approval
Template_1: Your requested account credit limit has been approved.

Title: Low Stock Alert
Template_Subject: Inventory has reached the reorder level
Template_1: A product has reached its reorder threshold and requires replenishment.

Title: Out of Stock Alert
Template_1: A product currently has no available inventory. Immediate action is recommended.

Title: Stock Transfer Notice
Template_1: A stock transfer has been initiated between warehouse locations.

Title: Product Approval Request
Template_1: A newly created product record is waiting for review and approval.

Title: Product Price Review
Template_1: A product selling price has been changed and requires finance review.

Title: Service Request Confirmation
Template_Subject: Your service request has been received
Template_1: Your service request was received and assigned to our support team.

Title: Warranty Expiry Reminder
Template_1: The warranty for a registered product will expire soon. Contact support for options.

Title: Password Reset Email
Template_1: A password reset was requested for your account. Follow the secure reset instructions.
